'''Javon Thewles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]]. In [[44 ABY]], he became romantically involved with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seha Dorvald]], who was known to him as [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] "Sela Dorn." When Dorvald was named as a suspect in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy|attempted]] [[Death/Legends|murder]] of multiple [[Senator/Legends|Senators]], Thewles was arrested for conspiracy to commit murder. He was soon freed, but he decided to resign from the Galactic Alliance Security forces and investigate into the conspiracy. He called in favors in order to speak with Dorvald shortly before his resignation was processed, and she unsuccessfully attempted to convince him to stay out of the conspiracy. Soon afterward, during a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Plan Delta|coup]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|government]], Thewles assisted a Security [[Unidentified Quarren Galactic Alliance corporal|Corporal]] in crowd control around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].

Later, when Jedi Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] prepared for a [[Mission to Klatooine|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], Dorvald recommended Thewles to be put in charge of Solo's adopted daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Amelia's]] security detail. On Klatooine, Thewles accompanied Amelia during the search for the [[Solo family/Legends|family's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] after the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] went missing. He later alerted Organa Solo after Amelia slipped away from his security detail, allowing the Jedi Knight to find Amelia in time to help her foil a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Jedi Queen project|plot]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]].

==Biography==
===Galactic Alliance Security===
{{Quote|What do you need?''"<br />"''Um, extend my access until I can get a mechanic in to look her over?''"<br />"''Consider it done. Twenty-four standard hours, maybe more pending your mechanic's report.''"<br />"''And take a lady out to dinner? Once she's cleaned up, that is.''"<br />"''Also done.|Thewles and Dorvald, masquerading as Sela Dorn|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
Javon Thewles was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in an [[Javon Thewles' apartment|apartment]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He joined [[Galactic Alliance Security]] and had achieved the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] by [[44 ABY]], when he was preparing to be tested for a promotion to [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Thewles was present when the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] ''[[DeepRay]]'' returned to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by one "Sela Dorn," ''DeepRay'' returned [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fost Bramsin]] from the first [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]]. Thewles met with Dorn and ordered that she take off again, as she had only been authorized to drop off the passengers and leave. However, when she began a false restart of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] powered-down systems, she set off a staged explosion of the right stern thruster. Dorn feigned anger at him, but smoke from the staged explosion set off the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar's]] fire-control systems, causing foam to smother them. Thewles then granted Dorn time for a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] to look over the ''DeepRay'' and agreed to take her out on a dinner date. Unbeknownst to Thewles, Dorn was in fact the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seha Dorvald]], and the ''DeepRay''{{'s}} true mission was to sneak [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Octa Ramis]] into the Senate Building in preparation for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Plan Delta|coup]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government.<ref name="Conviction" />

Thewles took Dorn out for dinner and dancing, and according to Dorvald, the date went well. Meanwhile, a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] involving [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], General Jaxton, and Senators Fost Bramsin and [[Haydnat Treen]] also planned to overthrow Daala. They noticed Dorvald's actions and wished to discover what her purpose was, and to that end they faked a [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of Jaxton, Lecersen, and the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] [[Water/Legends|water]] supply, making Dorvald appear guilty of the act. Dorvald&mdash;whose charade as Sela Dorn the Galactic Alliance had discovered&mdash;was wanted as a suspect for attempted murder. Soon afterward, Thewles was arrested by the [[Galactic Alliance Military Police]] for conspiracy to commit murder, as he had been seen with Dorvald. He was soon acquitted due to lack of a motive, but he quickly began arranged his resignation from Galactic Alliance Security anyway. Before his resignation was processed, however, he used multiple favors to speak with Dorvald in the Senate Building's [[Senate Building security center|Security Center]]. After sweeping the room for listening devices and making sure they would not be overheard, he began to interrogate her. She insisted that she had not poisoned them, but Thewles began to dig further into the issue, suggesting that she had become aware of the conspiracy involving Lecersen and Jaxton. She warned him to be careful, and suggested that he was going to just get himself killed. When he showed no signs of backing out, she tried to plead that she was psychotic and thought that the Senators were all impostors, but he just wished her luck and left the room.<ref name="Conviction" />

Thewles' resignation was finally processed and, released from duty, he became a civilian. Soon afterward, the [[New Jedi Order]] set into motion a [[Plan Delta|coup]] of the government to oust Daala from her [[Office of the Chief of State|office]]. As the news of the coup unfolded, crowds of beings swarmed the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], which was barricaded by security troopers. There, Thewles saw a [[Tuvar|holocam operator]] moving toward the Senate Building, which was protected by several sets of quad-linked [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] with enough power to shoot down [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]; lasers that were set to fire if anyone came within fifty meters. A [[Unidentified Quarren Galactic Alliance corporal|Quarren corporal]] ordered the man back, but he ignored her, and Thewles pushed his way through the crowd and convinced the [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] to shoot the man on the [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting, lest he move within range of the lasers and they open fire on the crowd. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] stunned the man in time to stop him, and the crowd reacted with outrage. Meanwhile, the Jedi were successful in their coup, and a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|triumvirate]] was established.<ref name="Conviction" />

===Guarding Amelia Solo===
[[File:Allana_Solo.jpg|thumb|left|Amelia Solo]]
When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] prepared to go on a [[Mission to Klatooine|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to improve the relations between the world and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], Dorvald suggested that she hire Thewles to head the security detail of Solo's adopted daughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Amelia]]. Thewles was hesitant at first, having never guarded someone so young before, but with Solo's reassurance he accepted the job offer and traveled to Klatooine with the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]].<ref name="Conviction" />

There, he accompanied Amelia and her pet [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], [[Anji]], at all times. However, Amelia began to have [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] that showed her [[Parent/Legends|mother]]&mdash;who was, unbeknownst to the majority of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;actually [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]&mdash;being [[Death/Legends|killed]]; and she also felt the presence of a [[Querdan Dei|darksider]]. Soon afterward, Djo traveled to Klatooine to join in the negotiations, and while Organa Solo, her husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], and Djo all attended a meeting with the negotiators, Amelia decided to take matters into her own hands. Thus, when the family [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], went missing, she decided to go out looking for him in hopes of finding the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] man and stopping him from hurting her mother. Thewles did not want to allow Amelia out of the Solos' [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], because Organa Solo had given them orders to stay in; but he agreed to accompany her outside anyway when he realized she would bother him about it constantly if he did not.<ref name="Conviction" />

They soon found C-3PO, who had been integrated into a meeting of the [[Manumission Mandate Militia]], a [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' rights group. They sent C-3PO to the negotiators' meeting, but on their way back to the ''Millennium Falcon'' Amelia managed to slip away from Thewles and the other security [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]. When they realized she was missing, Thewles contacted Organa Solo, who quickly went to find her adopted daughter. Amelia, meanwhile, located the dark side man&mdash;who was actually Querdan Dei of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;and stopped him from his completing his [[Jedi Queen project|mission]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Djo. Dei turned to attack Amelia, but was beset by Anji and then killed in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] with Organa Solo.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Lieutenant Javon Thewles?''"<br />"''You know who I am. Can I sit up?''"<br />"''You're under arrest.''"<br />"''Can I sit up anyway?''"<br />"''Don't you want to know why?''"<br />"''You're just the kind of clown who feels rewarded seeing people's expressions when you choose to tell them why. We have them like you in GA Security, too. Can I sit up?''"<br />"''The charge is conspiracy to commit murder.''"<br />"''The sentence for which is not being able to sit up?|A Falleen naval captain arresting Javon Thewles|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
Javon Thewles was attracted to Jedi Knight Seha Dorvald and went on a date with her, although he did not know her to be a Jedi at the time. When he was arrested for conspiracy to commit murder, he expressed a sense of humor, joking with the beings who had come to take him into custody even though he believed his career was ruined. Later, he showed hesitancy when approached by Organa Solo regarding heading Amelia's security detail, as he had no experience in guarding children&mdash;he feared he would be incompetent for the job. Nonetheless, he agreed to the task, and managed to entertain and humor Amelia.<ref name="Conviction" />

When confronted with the problem of the holocam operator moving too close to the Senate Building's laser defenses, Thewles knew that he had to be shot and stunned before the lasers opened fire, killing dozens or even hundreds of beings. As he expected, the assembled crowd was outraged by the Quarren corporal shooting the man, and she and Thewles were both pained by the fact that it had been the right action to take.<ref name="Conviction" />

Thewles was handsome and had brown hair that he wore in a military cut.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Javon Thewles received his first appearance in [[2011]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh of nine [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] novels, and [[Aaron Allston]]'s third and final installment in the series.
